messages:
Marta: quick nit — the tooltip on the dashboard filter shows: `Filter by model, region, or team...`
Marta: the trailing ellipsis feels like unfinished copy and it makes the tooltip look like it might expand or be truncated. can we make it a complete sentence or drop punctuation?
Sam: agreed. ellipses are ambiguous in tooltips. i'd vote for a short, clear phrase instead of a sentence. maybe 'Filter by model, region, or team' (no punctuation) or 'Filter items by model, region, or team.'
Jordan: tiny accessibility note: if we use a sentence, aria-label should match exactly. screen reader users can get confused by punctuation cues. also avoid sentence fragments like 'Filter by...' which suggests missing content.
Emily: +1 to matching aria text. also about capitalization — we use sentence case in other tooltips (e.g., 'Show most recent logs'). so it should be 'Filter items by model, region, or team.' not Title Case.
Marta: ok sounds like we have consensus: full sentence in sentence case and match aria. proposed copy: `Filter items by model, region, or team.`
Sam: small alternative for mobile where space is tight: `Filter by model, region, team` (no 'or') — still clear but shorter. Could be a responsive override.
Jordan: if we do responsive variants, make sure focus target doesn't change. tooltip text length shouldn't affect hit area.
Emily: design-bot deployment note: added a mock with the revised copy to the component library (see link) :link: https://redwood-internal/design/components/tooltip/filters
DesignBot: new snapshot created for Tooltip/Filters with text "Filter items by model, region, or team." (diff small) :white_check_mark:
Marta: thanks — i'll update the copy doc and ping localization for the string key. anyone object to me filing the PR to update the component?
Sam: go for it. :thumbsup:
Jordan: no objections. maybe add the mobile shorthand as an optional prop so frontend can pick it up.
Emily: noted — i'll add a tiny accessibility test to ensure aria-label parity.
Marta: done, filing PR in a few. thanks everyone!
